findings.summary: Spec §2 criteria 5, 6, and 6b explicitly require tests that actually execute bin/e0-regression.sh with a fake-loop executable stub (spec lines 326-328: '判据 5 与 6 的测试必须真正执行 bin/e0-regression.sh 本身…前一版 attempt 1 的 blocker：测试在自己内部重实现了一遍循环、对入口只做源码 grep，于是入口怎么错都是绿的'). The implemented tests in test/e0c2-termination.test.ts (判据 6b at lines 437-447 and 判据 5/6 at lines 459-493) only readFileSync the entry script and regex-match its source text (toMatch on 'DRAIN_REASON.*max_rounds', 'while true; do', 'HIT WALL CLOCK LIMIT', etc.). None of them execute bin/e0-regression.sh. This is exactly the forbidden pattern: the cross-drain loop, the GT-6 max_rounds+exit-1 vs other-non-zero classification, the limit-hit exit codes, and the failure-branch drain stdout/stderr echo are all unverified at runtime — any regression in those behaviors (e.g. inverting the classification, breaking a break condition, or moving the record-append before the echo) leaves these tests green. The fake-loop stub injection pattern the spec requires (deep-research-loop.sh replaced by an executable stub that emits a controlled drain summary + exit code per attempt) is absent.
